answer.summary: Investigate empirical evidence of token-level semantic drift in agent outputs under intermittent input using time-series linguistic embedding models with controlled perturbations and bounded token budgets.
answer.content: Search for peer-reviewed studies that measure output token coherence and semantic drift in response to intermittent input streams, using time-series linguistic embedding models, and report explicit decay rates and per-interval coherence metrics under bounded token budgets and known perturbations. Focus on studies with controlled experimental conditions and direct, measurable output-level metrics.
answer.nextTask: Analyze time-series linguistic embedding study on tokenized agent output drift under intermittent input with bounded token budgets
answer.lesson: All claims about tokenized agent memory performance must be grounded in direct, time-series empirical data from peer-reviewed studies with explicit decay and coherence metrics under controlled input conditions before comparative analysis is valid.'
